newsitem.title: USA: Oceaneering to expand fleet of rigs.
newsitem.headline: Oceaneering to expand fleet of rigs.

text.p: Oceaneering International Inc said on Wednesday its board of directors has authorized further expansion of the company's fleet of deepwater rigs.
Five new Hydra Magnum work class remotely operated vehicles will be manufactured at Oceaneering's Morgan City, Louisiana facility for delivery between April and June 1997, the company said.

These units are being built to meet increased market demand around the world for rigs capable of working in water depths greater than 1,000 feet and in severe weather conditions, such as those encountered in the North Sea, the company said.
The five vehicles raise the total number of fleet expansion vehicles since last December to 22, Oceaneering said.
